Query: I am a pre-school teacher for ages 3-4. Please provide me a detailed report on a strategy for the following situation: One student doesn't want to share and always gets into tantrums when I tell them about the sharing rules. During these tantrums, they hurt other students. They bargain with ice cream, saying they will stop if they get some. I tried to follow a gentle, preventative approach, but it doesn't work for this student.
Passage: Our Services

Our services are designed to support your child at home, school and community. From direct services, parent coaching to IEP Review and School FBAs, we are dedicated to creating an environment for your child or loved one to excel and grow.

Direct Therapy

Age Range: Catering specifically to children, and adolescents aged 18 months to 18 years old.

Home-Based: Our therapists visit your child in the comfort and familiarity of their own home, ensuring a safe and conducive environment for learning.

Play Skills: Teaching the art of shared joy, from solitary to cooperative play, ensuring your child can engage in fun, developmental activities.

Social Interaction: Nurturing the essential skills needed to interact with peers, from taking turns to understanding emotions, setting the stage for building meaningful relationships.

Parent Coaching

Tailored Coaching Sessions: Every child is unique, and so are their challenges. Whether it's mitigating tantrums, fostering new skills, or enhancing daily routines, we craft strategies that align with your child's needs and your family's dynamics.

Collaborative Approach: We believe in the power of partnership. By working closely with parents, we ensure that therapeutic strategies are consistently implemented, maximizing their effectiveness.

Empowering Parents: Equipping you with the tools, techniques, and insights to confidently support your child's growth and development every day.

IEP Review

We understand the importance of being actively involved in your child's Individualized Education Program (IEP). We can attend IEP meetings with you to provide our professional perspective and advocacy. Our board certified behavior analysts (BCBAs) have extensive experience collaborating with schools to develop appropriate IEP goals tailored to your child's needs. We review IEPs with a careful eye, looking at the goals, services, accommodations, and more to ensure your child is receiving the supports they require to make meaningful progress. If any part of the IEP is unclear or seems insufficient, we can help explain terminology, ask clarifying questions, and push for proper services.

School FBAs

(Functional Behavior Assessment)

Behaviors in the classroom often stem from underlying issues that require understanding. Our team of Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) partners with schools to conduct comprehensive Functional Behavior Assessments (FBAs) to uncover the root causes of behaviors so positive interventions can be created.

The FBA process typically involves:

Classroom observations to identify antecedents, behaviors, and consequences. Detailed notes are taken to detect patterns.

Interviews with teachers, parents, counselors, and other staff to gain insights on behavior triggers, reactions, and possible functions.

Reviewing documents like IEPs and office referrals for important details.

Tracking data on behavior frequency, duration, and other variables.

A report that summarizes behavior triggers, reinforcing consequences, and the likely purpose the behavior serves.

With the FBA complete, our BCBAs work closely with school staff to develop a Behavior Intervention Plan outlining positive strategies tailored to the student's needs and behavior functions. We also provide training on implementation, progress monitoring, and adjusting the plan as required.

Request Your Free Consultation

Take the first step and contact us today. We ready to learn about your specific situation and are happy to answer any questions you have.
